intent: Specify the public API of `pulz_bitset::BitSet` (a growable set of `usize` backed by `Vec<u64>`): `new`, `clear`, `from_range`, `insert_range`, `contains`, `is_empty`, `contains_all`, `insert`, `remove`, `find_next`, `extend_bitset`, `remove_bitset`, `retain_bitset` and `is_disjoint`. In Lean these are `pulz_bitset.BitSet.<name>` with `BitSet = alloc.vec.Vec Std.U64`; ranges are `core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize` (`{ start := a, «end» := b }`); `&mut self` methods return the new set (`insert`/`remove` return the pair (result, new set)).

manual_mutants.note: bit index within the word masked with 31 instead of 63
from_range leaves the full middle words empty
insert_range forgets to fill the full middle words
manual_mutants.before: let s1 ← core.slice.Slice.fill core.U64.Insts.CoreCloneClone s i5

manual_mutants.note: remove reports the opposite of whether the value was present
insert reports whether the value was already present instead of newly inserted
find_next moves to the next word one bit too early (skips bit 63 of each word)
contains_all checks the wrong direction (other ⊇ self word-wise)
retain_bitset computes the union of the common words

sibling_mutants.note: remove never trims trailing zero words (internal layout only; same set)
remove_bitset/retain_bitset never trim trailing zero words (internal layout only)

bug_variants.note: Pre-fix from_range (pulz commit f6d6563, extracted unmodified): the offset inside the first word is taken from range.end instead of range.start, the words below the range are filled with ones instead of zeros, and an inverted range takes the non-empty path. from_range(a..b) then contains elements outside [a, b).

edits.with_text:
def BitSet.from_range
  (range : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) : RustM BitSet := do
  let words_from ← range.start / 64#usize
  let words_to ← range.end / 64#usize
  let words_from_rest ← range.end % 64#usize
  let i ← words_to + 1#usize
  let result ← alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity Std.U64 i
  let result1 ←
    alloc.vec.Vec.resize core.U64.Insts.CoreCloneClone result words_from
      core.num.U64.MAX
  if words_from = words_to
  then
    let value ← lift (~~~ 0#u64)
    let value1 ←
      if words_from_rest != 0#usize
      then value <<< words_from_rest
      else ok value
    let value2 ←
      if words_from_rest != 0#usize
      then
        do
        let i1 ← lift (~~~ 0#u64)
        let i2 ← i1 <<< words_from_rest
        let i3 ← lift (~~~ i2)
        ok (value1 &&& i3)
      else ok value1
    if value2 != 0#u64
    then let result2 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push result1 value2
         ok result2
    else ok result1
  else
    let result2 ←
      if words_from_rest != 0#usize
      then
        do
        let i1 ← lift (~~~ 0#u64)
        let i2 ← i1 <<< words_from_rest
        alloc.vec.Vec.push result1 i2
      else ok result1
    let result3 ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.resize core.U64.Insts.CoreCloneClone result2 words_to
        core.num.U64.MAX
    if words_from_rest != 0#usize
    then
      let i1 ← lift (~~~ 0#u64)
      let i2 ← i1 <<< words_from_rest
      let i3 ← lift (~~~ i2)
      let result4 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push result3 i3
      ok result4
    else ok result3
